NTA AIAPGET Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the answer key for the All India Ayush Post Graduate Entrance Test (AIAPGET 2026) on the official website of the NTA AIAPGET recently. Online registration process for NTA AIAPGET Admission 2026 were accepted from 10 July 2026 to 30 July 2026. The examination was held on 22 August 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this Examination can download their NTA AIAPGET Answer Key 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 10 July 2026
  • Last Date : 30 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 July 2026
  • Correction Date : 01-02 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 22 August 2026
  • Exam City Details : 13 August 2026
  • Admit Card : 18 August 2026
  • Answer key : 18 August 2026

Application Fee

  • General : Rs. 2700/-
  • OBC NCL, EWS : Rs. 2450/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 1800/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.
